title: RGB released a new single titled "Tell me what you want"
htmlContent:
Los Angeles-based artist Rgb releases a beautiful single, "tell me what you want," a fresh scene in the music industry that gets all the right beats and brings a wavy feel when listened to.

"Tell me what you want"it's a straightforward song. It is a fun and melodic song. This song is an ode for those who don't beat around the bus and like hitting the nail on the head.

*Tell me what you want" is an alternative indie R&B mix of lo-fi pop and a touch of hip-hop. It is everything you envisioned an alternative R&B to be and more. It has beautiful melodies and is so fun to listen to with a wavy yet energetic feel.

The sounds are rhythmic and a fantastic rendition from Rgb."Tell me what you want" is a song that will be stuck in your head for days.

Rgb is an Asian American artist and a seasoned multi-versed musician in many music genres. He makes music that transcends different genres, is very talented, and plays the classical piano.

His songs are filled with different melodies and technically skilled instruments that create a fantastic atmosphere, and his multifaceted skills create the best sounds for you to listen to. Hearing about his project, we had to feature him on our page.

Stream "Tell me what you want" on Spotify 

Connect with Rgb on Instagram.
